caption:
Google has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model yet, specifically designed for cybersecurity tasks. With the ability to autonomously find and patch software vulnerabilities, Argon is already being utilized by Google's staff for daily coding tasks. This new model is set to reshape the landscape of AI in cybersecurity and beyond! 4e14bb
